methodology: Repository metadata and project README reviewed; not a claim of executed or security-audited software.

resources.name: OpenTakeoff
resources.summary: PDF drawing measurement for area, length, counts and trade quantities, with CSV/Excel exports and agent-ready MCP tooling.
resources.caution: Static browser deployment is documented. One-Click automatic room detection is currently gated by the upstream project; manual polygons remain available.

resources.name: OpenConstructionERP
resources.summary: BOQ editing, composite rates, assemblies, PDF/CAD/BIM quantities, and cost/project management.
resources.caution: Large backend application; not deployable on GitHub Pages alone. Verify regional prices and cost-database licensing before professional use.

resources.name: Bidwright
resources.summary: AI-assisted bid intake, PDF and model takeoff, rate schedules, labor burdens, assemblies and quotations.
resources.caution: Requires Docker and a multi-service stack; AI providers may require separate credentials or paid usage. New and changing quickly.

resources.name: Construction Tender Assembly Builder
resources.summary: Browser estimating tool for BOQ normalization, historical assemblies, cost codes, and rate/productivity adjustments.
resources.caution: Small recent project; the separate Excel workbench advertised by the author is a commercial download, not automatically included in the repository.

resources.name: IfcOpenShell / Ifc5D
resources.summary: IFC quantity and cost automation, schedules of rates, cost items and structured CSV/Excel outputs.
resources.caution: Development toolkit; requires IFC models and Python/IFC knowledge, not a point-and-click PDF takeoff application.

resources.name: FreeCAD BIM
resources.summary: Open-source parametric CAD/BIM application with integrated BIM workbench and quantity-oriented model workflows.
resources.caution: The historical standalone BIM_Workbench addon is obsolete for FreeCAD 1.0+; BIM is integrated into FreeCAD itself.

resources.name: QTO Buccaneer
resources.summary: Python quantity takeoff from IFC models with spreadsheet exports, metrics and reusable workflows.
resources.caution: Requires a working IFC model and Python dependencies; check measurement classification and model completeness.

resources.name: FreeCAD Bill of Materials Workbench
resources.summary: FreeCAD assembly-part bills of materials, including summary BOM and raw material item exports.
resources.caution: A BOM is not necessarily a priced construction BOQ; verify quantity units and assembly scope.

resources.name: PyCostEstimates (pyRevit)
resources.summary: Revit model quantities, composite unit-rate buildup, cost assignment and BOQ export.
resources.caution: Requires Autodesk Revit and pyRevit; Revit itself is proprietary and must be licensed separately.

resources.name: ezdxf
resources.summary: Programmatic reading, creation and analysis of DXF geometry for bespoke CAD takeoff workflows.
resources.caution: DXF geometry does not automatically establish construction pay quantities; layers, units and assemblies need project-specific rules.

resources.name: pdfplumber
resources.summary: Extract tables, text and document geometry from PDF BOQs, tender documents and schedules.
resources.caution: PDF extraction needs reconciliation against original documents; this library is not a finished drawing takeoff application.

resources.name: BuildSuite Core
resources.summary: ERPNext construction addon for BOQ trees, rate libraries, measurement books and subcontract payment processes.
resources.caution: Explicitly marked beta by its maintainer; requires a Frappe/ERPNext instance and suitable accounting configuration.

resources.name: OpenProject Community
resources.summary: Project scheduling, work packages, time records, budgeting, reporting and controlled team collaboration.
resources.caution: Project controls system, not a FIDIC clause interpreter or a dedicated construction variation-valuation engine.

resources.name: Construction Project Control Web App
resources.summary: Single-project budget, progress billing, change-order tracking, retainage and cash-flow demonstration.
resources.caution: Browser code is public; the separate downloadable Excel template is advertised commercially. Do not confuse the two.

resources.name: AI Skills for Construction
resources.summary: Prompt and agent-workflow examples for construction data, BIM analysis, document controls and estimating.
resources.caution: An AI skill collection is guidance, not a verified quantity calculation or contractual entitlement determination.

resources.name: QuantityTakeoff-Python examples
resources.summary: Small Python quantity takeoff examples for grouping and filtering construction model elements.
resources.caution: Older learning material (last repository activity reviewed from 2023); not recommended as a production takeoff engine.
